test.title: scaleCurrentHp trunc 截断（99→49）与满血减半（100→50）

mutation.find:
next.hp = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(next.maxHP, Math.trunc((next.hp * eff.numerator) / eff.denominator)),
          )
mutation.replace:
next.hp = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(next.maxHP, Math.round((next.hp * eff.numerator) / eff.denominator)),
          )
